Card Q&A.a: It can play 1 [Mineral] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 8 or less, or it can play 1 [Rock] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 8 or less.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played using this card's [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [All Turns] While your opponent has a Digimon with 13000 DP or more, this Digimon gets +5000 DP.
[On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 8 or less among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
